boundaries: Research one exact record and source at a time; a page about a family, sibling SKU, or other generation does not resolve a lead without an explicit identity bridge.
For PARDUS support, separate a general contact/dealer route from warranty duration, eligibility, generation, seller, and build coverage; do not contact the manufacturer or seller.
For the Uragano EVO, current Sport catalog specifications do not transfer to the older EVO/custom lead without an exact mapping.
For LightCarbon, Speed7/速7, LCR017-D, customer-post components, and SPEEDZ complete-build equipment remain separate until an exact build bridge is documented.
For each candidate price, record a dated public observation only when the exact product and purchasable package/channel are attributable; keep frame-only offers and custom builds distinct.
Treat stiffness evidence as a field measurement or a credible, controlled exact-frame test; seller language, frame category, or rider impression alone is not a stiffness result.
Do not send messages, access private content, bypass authentication or challenges, infer exact specifications, or make images part of this batch.
done_criteria: For each of the 15 frozen fields, reuse same-field accepted sources if they suffice, otherwise collect current public evidence. Integrate only facts that the source attributes to the exact record; preserve unresolved values with the existing unknowns and a concrete reopening trigger. Carry forward unchanged prior public-post channels where appropriate. Run npm run check once after batch integration; no image report is needed unless image records change.
delivery_boundary: One local delivery only. No push, pull request, merge, publication, seller contact, purchase, or production change.
